speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent travel and camping history, have you experienced any fever, joint pain, or noticed a rash, particularly on your wrists or ankles? I also need to know if you have had any headaches or if your fatigue is accompanied by muscle aches.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify if you have any double vision, as "diplopia" refers to seeing two images, and if you have noticed any weakness in your limbs or face that worsens with activity. Do you have a history of thyroid disease or autoimmune conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history provided. Social history: Enjoys outdoor activities such as hiking and camping. No mention of smoking, alcohol, or drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned mild diplopia; does this double vision worsen as the day progresses or with sustained upward gaze? I also need to know if you experience any difficulty with swallowing, speaking, or shortness of breath, and whether your leg or arm strength fluctuates throughout the day.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, headache, or any respiratory, gastrointestinal, or urinary symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your symptoms worsen with activity and you have diplopia without other systemic signs, I need to rule out neuromuscular junction disorders. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine receptor antibody test. REQUEST TEST: Repetitive nerve stimulation.
